What we do

A practical bridge between supply and demand.

HSS Group LLC is a California-based general wholesale, distribution, sourcing, and trading company. We work across product categories according to buyer requirements, supplier capabilities, and the needs of each transaction.

Representative trade categories

Flexible sourcing across commercial categories.

HSS Group LLC is not limited to one industry or product line. We evaluate opportunities project by project, including general commercial goods and food or agricultural commodities.

General wholesale goods

Commercial inquiries considered against a defined buyer requirement.

  • Product-specific wholesale inquiries
  • Specifications and packaging details
  • Volume, lead time, and commercial terms
  • Domestic and international opportunities

Food & agricultural commodities

One active category within our broader trading work, handled according to product and destination needs.

  • Frozen, shelf-stable, and packaged goods
  • Case packing, pallet, and container planning
  • Applicable quality and compliance documentation
  • Manufacturer and supplier quotations

Our process

A clear starting point for every inquiry.

Send the core commercial information needed to understand the opportunity.

Share the requirement

Identify the product, specifications, pack size, expected volume, destination, timing, and preferred delivery term.

Identify the parties

Include the buyer, supplier, or manufacturer details relevant to the inquiry and the best business contact.

Provide commercial terms

State the quotation basis, payment terms, minimum order quantity, lead time, and freight responsibility.

Attach supporting documents

Send current specifications, packaging details, and applicable quality or compliance documents with the offer.
